content:
**Glowing Meat Steak** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A piece of Glowing Meat which has been cooked over a fire, minimizing its radioactive nature and improving its nutritional value.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Glowing Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Glowing Meat | | Glowing Meat Steak (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station after having picked up Glowing Meat for the first time.
